prompt: Repair snippets/pagination-window.liquid. paginate.current and paginate.pages are integers with 1 <= current <= pages. When pages is 1 output nothing. Otherwise output one nav class=pagination containing, in order: an a class=prev with href ?page=P and text Previous when current > 1 (P is current - 1); then each page n from max(1, current - 2) to min(pages, current + 2), where the current page is a span class=current with text n and every other page an a with href ?page=n and text n; then an a class=next with href ?page=N and text Next when current < pages (N is current + 1). Output only the specified elements/attributes; escape dynamic text and attributes. Inter-element whitespace, comments and quote style may vary; leaf text is exact. Change only snippets/pagination-window.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
